claims.text: Important elements of prompt engineering for applied linguistics include persona, audience, contexts, instruction, and output specification.
Iterative prompting and few-shot prompting are strategies to handle complex tasks in applied linguistics.
Prompt engineering practical tips can mitigate LLM shortcomings such as data privacy issues, potential bias, lack of explainability, and hallucinations.

evidence.description: This study aims to elaborate on the important elements of prompt engineering, including persona, audience, contexts, instruction, and output specification.
Besides, this study also delineates several important prompting strategies to handle more complex tasks, such as iterative prompting and few-shot prompting.

Most importantly, it provides some practical tips to mitigate the potential shortcomings of LLMs, including data privacy, potential bias, explainability, and hallucinations, from the perspective of prompt engineering.

methodologies.name: Applied Linguistics Prompt Engineering Framework
methodologies.description: A structured framework detailing prompt components, complex strategies like iterative and few-shot prompting, and practical mitigation techniques for LLM limitations in language learning and testing contexts.

limitations.text: How to write an effective prompt remains underexplored in applied linguistics.
Large language models exhibit potential shortcomings including data privacy risks, potential bias, lack of explainability, and hallucinations.
